en.aquaColor.hint: When set, takes priority over wallpaper tint; Default restores auto (this picker is disabled while Panel-colors-match-wallpaper is on)
en.aquaInk.desc: Text color adapts to mask brightness (dark text on light / light on dark) and hard-coded brand blues are unified to ink-derived colors
en.aquaInkColor.hint: Send button / primary buttons / plugin text use it (default = adaptive ink); a dark color keeps the send arrow visible
en.aquaMask.desc: Every surface (sidebar/title bar/chat/buttons) shares one fog color (strength by the Unified-fog-strength slider below) instead of per-area fog; off = keep the current per-area fog
en.aquaTextEnhance.desc: Adds a dual-color text outline to chat text so it stays readable over black/dark backgrounds (approximation - cannot limit to text passing over dark areas only; off by default)
en.aquaTint.desc: On = auto-sample the wallpaper's dominant color as the panel base (videos/GIFs refresh every 2s), the Custom mask color picker below is disabled; Off = pick a color manually with the picker
en.backup.bad: Invalid backup file or no plugin settings inside
en.backup.desc: Export/import appearance settings (Appearance · Unified Blur · UI Blur · Aqua · Other; not the current wallpaper or scanned dirs). Exported file can be shared
en.backup.title: Backup & Restore
en.blur.follow.hint: The frost amounts below are taken over by the two sliders on the “Surface unify” page while Unified blur is on. Turn the switch below off to make them independent. Rows that are not taken over (dialogs / settings panel / download-confirm / popovers / mask) always stay independent.
en.blur.overridden: Unified blur + Chat-follows are both on: wallpaper blur is taken over by the Full-screen blur degree slider, so this frosted slider is disabled; turn off "Chat follows full-screen blur" to restore it (unified blur then only controls sidebar/title-bar fog)
en.blur.unsupported: ⚠️ This browser (Via/WebView) does not truly render backdrop blur; blur appears as translucency only. Use Chrome/Firefox for the full frosted effect
en.blurFollowUnify.desc: On (default) = the taken-over rows here (left sidebar frost / title-bar frost / right sidebar · dock) stay identical to “UI transparency” + “Full-screen blur degree”. Any row you adjust yourself becomes independent from that moment on. Off = all of them independent. Turning this switch back on clears the independent markers and makes all four surfaces identical again.
en.bs.aqua.desc: Double switch: this + the matching Aqua experiment toggle (unified fog / panel tint / adaptive ink) both on = the effect applies to better-sidebar panels
en.bs.desc: dsh-better-sidebar detected. Master off = no adaptation (sidebar keeps its native look); turn it on to enable the individual items below
en.bs.float.desc: Apply the floating-card look (rounded corners/margins) to better-sidebar panels too (without clipping content)
en.bs.font.desc: better-sidebar text follows the custom gray-text / dark-background readability settings
en.bs.master.desc: Master switch: off disables every adaptation below
en.bs.reveal.desc: better-sidebar panel backgrounds become translucent so the wallpaper shows through (follows the transparency sliders)
en.bs.title: dsh-better-sidebar compatibility
en.chatFollow.desc: When unified blur is on: On = the chat area wallpaper blur also follows the Full-screen blur degree (frosted slider taken over & disabled); Off = the frosted slider becomes adjustable again and the chat-area wallpaper follows it (unified blur still owns the UI shell: sidebar / title bar / right sidebar / dock)
en.clock.desc: Overlay a live clock on the background, replacing the built-in time component
en.clock.title: Show time (clock)
en.composerBlur.desc: Drops the gradient slab above the composer and frosts the composer card itself: fixes transcript text bleeding through when the base colour is translucent (off by default, the slab is useful on default themes). Turns on automatically when the host base colour is measured translucent; switching it off here means never auto-enabling it
en.confirmBlur.desc: Backdrop blur of this plugin's download-confirm, conflict-detection and error popups; off = opaque popups
en.conflict.body: These plugins may conflict with this feature (both alter the UI background/appearance). Enable anyway?
en.conflict.title: Plugin conflict detected
en.desc: Load Wallpaper Engine .mpkg files as the page background: video wallpapers play their embedded mp4, scene wallpapers use their preview.gif. Supports time-of-day switching, a clock, lens zoom, and UI frosted blur. Settings persist in this browser.
en.diag.fields: New report fields: ctxLost=WebGL context-loss counter, maxTextureSize=device texture limit (for oversized-black-layer evidence), layerHealth=per-layer health (reported via mpw-health, planned). Per-layer debug flags ln/eyehack/novideo/ownsize can be passed into the wallpaper via “Renderer debug params” above.
en.diag.more: Full list: the renderer repo docs README-DIAGNOSTICS.md (node diag-flag-check.mjs verifies code/doc consistency).
en.diag.sec.desc: Append to the renderer URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:8902/webloader/?id=3719111841&audit=3. Common flags below; press Copy to grab the URL fragment.
en.diagflag.align.d: ?align=0: legacy alignment (origin always geometric center) for A/B.
en.diagflag.att.d: ?att=legacy: old self-computed anchor offsets (vs the ported elysia implementation; large error, A/B only).
en.diagflag.audio.d: ?audio=1: play scene sound layers (one stream per layer; may need a user gesture).
en.diagflag.audit.d: ?audit=N: audit the first N frames layer by layer to locate a stuck render.
en.diagflag.gyro.d: ?gyro=1 force on / ?gyro=0 no deviceorientation listener at all / default auto (off when a fine pointer exists, on for touch devices): beta/gamma feed the same u,v pointer source as the mouse, so parallax g_ParallaxPosition, particles, trails and script pointers all follow.
en.diagflag.hier.d: ?hier=0: drop parent-chain composition, fall back to refrender absolute positioning.
en.diagflag.isolate.d: ?isolate=<name>: keep only layers whose name contains the keyword(s) visible.
en.diagflag.mcc.d: ?mcc=1: force mesh-bbox center compensation (legacy behavior; the official has none).
en.diagflag.parallax.d: ?parallax=legacy: old lwe-approx mouse parallax; the official formula is default.
en.diagflag.piv.d: ?piv=1 all on / ?piv=0 all off; default applies to the eye group only.
en.diagflag.whitefallback.d: ?whitefallback=0: missing textures turn transparent instead of the official white block.
en.diagsend.desc: Packages the key subsystem state (whether frosting / sidebar / timeline rail are affected, wallpaper type and path, whether the shim was injected, video decode state, surface tokens, scene health) and sends it back to the local host, landing in ~/.dsh/.dsh-mpkg-wallpaper/diag-<timestamp>.json. Every field carries its provenance; unreadable fields are not dropped but marked null + a degraded reason. If the host is unavailable it falls back to downloading the JSON file (works offline).
en.dialogBlur.desc: Generic center-screen windows (not the settings panel / not this plugin's popups) and the chat input box get a blurred backdrop; text scrolling under the input box turns hazy. The settings panel and download/confirm popups have their own switches
en.error.title: Import failed
en.ffmpeg.downloadHint: Download installs into the plugin's cache dir (does not touch system/env ffmpeg)
en.ffmpeg.uninstallHint: Only removes the cached binary; never touches system PATH / env ffmpeg
en.file.hint: Images/GIF supported (large files auto-saved locally, persist on refresh)
en.file.tooLarge: File exceeds 100MB — pick another or use a URL.
en.float.desc: Sidebar/title bar become floating cards (rounded + shadow + see-through frosted wallpaper); off by default, existing transparency/blur features stay intact
en.fontColorGray.desc: On without a color keeps the theme gray (same as off); pick a color to tint all secondary/tertiary/dimmed gray text and separator/border grays
en.fontColorGray.hint: After picking a color, overrides label-secondary/tertiary/caption/dimmed/quaternary/primary-bluish and separator/border/warning grays (~17 gray tokens); no color = theme gray (=off state)
en.fpsCap.hint: When the source fps exceeds the cap, the video is transcoded via host ffmpeg before playback (ffmpeg required; not applicable to web wallpapers)
en.glass.accent.hint: Drives brand interactive elements (buttons/sliders/selection/links/send button); the theme color owns the overall background tint
en.glass.color.hint: Glass background tint (default: white in light / deep night blue in dark; both themes use the picked color)
en.glass.desc: Glassmorphism for the settings card/dialog: glass tint + white overlay strength + master switch (independent of the other Aqua features; off by default)
en.glass.title: Liquid glass (elysia395 approach)
en.headerBg: Show wallpaper behind the title bar
en.headerBg.desc: Off makes the title bar solid white (solid dark in dark theme), no wallpaper behind it
en.headerBg.unifyHint: Unified blur is on: title bar translucency follows the Surface opacity slider (turn this switch off for a fully opaque title bar)
en.headerBlur.desc: Title bar shows the wallpaper; frosted amount via the slider below (default 0 = transparent, so the session-log button is not wrapped in a white rectangle; raise it for a readable fog). Needs "Show wallpaper behind the title bar" on
en.headerBlur.overridden: Unified blur is on: title-bar frost is taken over by the Full-screen blur degree + Left sidebar / title-bar opacity. Turn off “UI blur follows Unified blur” on the UI-blur page to adjust this switch again
en.headerFrostOwn.desc: Off by default: title bar frost follows the global blur amount (it cannot be switched off on its own while global blur is on, or the wallpaper shows through). Turn on to set the radius with the slider below
en.hybrid: Upload to dsh for streaming playback
en.hybrid.desc: On: mpkg is uploaded to the DSH host and streamed (>600MB supported; restart dsh web for the host half). Off: all files play in the local browser (600MB cap)
en.hybrid.status.fallback: Host side unavailable (fell back to browser-only, 600MB cap)
en.hybrid.status.ok: Host side available (no 600MB limit for large files)
en.lg.demo.desc: WebGL2 liquid glass demo: built-in gradient + upload your own video; drag sliders to see refraction/frost/dispersion live
en.lg.glassTitle: Glass layer switches (overlay onto the DSH UI)
en.lg.note: ⚠ The demo page is a standalone service (tools/liquid-demo/server.mjs), independent of the main plugin; overlaying the glass layer onto the DSH UI is still in progress.
en.lg.test.desc: ON: only wallpaper + float + layout; appearance features disabled
en.lgCss.desc: Pure CSS/SVG liquid glass: refraction + specular edges on sidebar / title bar / composer (Chromium). Uses no WebGL context, so it can run alongside a scene wallpaper; falls back to plain blur when unsupported
en.lib.audioFiles: (.mp3/.ogg/.oga/.opus/.wav/.flac/.m4a/.aac; detected by extension + header bytes) — played by the music card, not listed as wallpapers
en.lib.customHint: You can point directly at the Steam Workshop root (workshop/content/431960): every subfolder is auto-detected as a wallpaper (scene.pkg scene / mp4 video / index.html web); any folder works too — .pkg / .mpkg single files and workshop folders can be mixed freely (a loose .pkg in the root is listed too)
en.lib.desc: On Windows with Wallpaper Engine installed, discovers video/web wallpapers
en.lib.dirEmpty: Enter a wallpaper folder path first
en.lib.empty: No usable wallpapers found (or not a Windows environment)
en.lib.kbdHint: Tip: click the list (or Tab into it) to use ↑↓ to move, Home/End for first/last, Enter to open (with no row selected it chooses this folder), Backspace for parent, Esc to close. Opening the dialog never moves your focus or your scroll position.
en.lib.noHost: Host unavailable — cannot scan the local library
en.lib.noInstall: Wallpaper Engine install not found (requires Windows + Steam Wallpaper Engine)
en.lib.rotateDesc: Automatically switch to the next wallpaper on a timer (range: custom folder + local library + Steam-discovered video wallpapers)
en.lib.rotMerged: Playable Steam-library videos merged into the rotation:
en.lib.sceneOnly: Scene wallpapers cannot be rendered in the browser (preview only)
en.lib.title: Local wallpaper library (Steam discovery)
en.lib.webPending: Web (HTML) wallpaper support is in development; use mpkg import for now
en.maskBlur.desc: Haziness of the translucent backdrop layer behind a window when settings/popovers open
en.master.off: Disabled (conflicting wallpaper/theme plugins detected or manually off)
en.mpkg.compressed: This container's entry is a compressed entry (LZ4 block chain); the mpkg path does not decompress, so playback would receive compressed bytes — import it as a folder instead (the renderer-side parser decompresses)
en.mpkg.dropHint: Dropped file accepted — parsing the container…
en.mpkg.hint: Wallpaper Engine .pkg single files (scene.pkg) and .mpkg packages are both supported — you can also drop a file anywhere on this panel; mp4/webm video files work here too; video wallpapers play their embedded mp4
en.mpkg.huge: File too large (>600MB) — mobile browsers cannot handle it; pick a smaller mpkg
en.mpkg.noAsset: No image/GIF asset found in this mpkg
en.mpkg.oom: File too large — out of memory while parsing. Use a wallpaper under 300MB or view it in the Wallpaper Engine app
en.mpkg.previewMode: Preview mode: showing the preview image; the wallpaper's full dynamic content (Live2D scene/HD video) requires the Wallpaper Engine app
en.mpkg.quota: Browser storage quota exceeded; free up space (clear other wallpapers) and retry
en.mpkg.tableTooLarge: This container's entry table is too large (over 32MB) — the current import path cannot read the index (this is NOT "no asset"). Make sure it is a Wallpaper Engine .pkg/.mpkg container; for oversized tables import it as a folder instead
en.mpkg.tooLarge: Background asset too large (video >600MB / image >200MB) — the browser cannot handle it
en.mpkg.videoHuge: Video too large (>600MB) — the browser cannot play it; automatically fell back to the preview image
en.mpkg.vtexBig: This wallpaper's video texture exceeds 250MB — the browser cannot play it (view it in the Wallpaper Engine app)
en.mpkg.webOnly: This container only holds web files (index.html) with no image/video asset: it is a web wallpaper — import it via "choose folder / scan directory" instead (project.json inside the container is not used for this decision; some upstream packages do not ship one)
en.mute.desc: Web wallpapers often have audio; muted by default. Off = play wallpaper sound
en.newStyle.desc: Toggles and the speed selector use the new style (track switch + radio dots); off = old style
en.np.noAudio: This video has no audio track (shown as-is, no fake sound)
en.np.note.decode: The audio track failed to load (unsupported format, or the host could not serve the bytes)
en.np.note.gesture: To avoid blocked unmuted autoplay, the first sound needs one click on the page (afterwards the setting applies)
en.np.note.linkOff: "Play/pause also controls the wallpaper" is off: the transport only drives this plugin's own player, the wallpaper's own playback is untouched
en.np.note.linkOffSoundOnly: "Play/pause also controls the wallpaper" is off: play/pause only toggles this track's sound (the picture keeps playing)
en.np.note.nolist: This wallpaper has a single audio track, so there is no previous/next (no fake playlist)
en.np.note.noseek: This position is not draggable right now: there is no seekable media (with the link switch off, the wallpaper's own position is left alone)
en.np.note.nosource: This wallpaper has no controllable audio track: the plugin has no system media source, so the transport controls are unavailable (see docs/NOW-PLAYING-DSH.md)
en.np.note.novolume: This wallpaper has no controllable volume channel: only video/web wallpaper sound can be controlled
en.np.note.pkgListOnly: The audio lives inside the package (scene.pkg) and the host has no route to serve its bytes, so the list is real but playback is not possible
en.np.title: Now playing
en.npLinkWallpaper.desc: On (default): the Now playing transport also drives the wallpaper's own playback and position. Off: only this plugin's own player is driven and the wallpaper's playback is untouched (when the wallpaper media is the only sound source the controls are honestly disabled). On by default = byte-identical to the previous behaviour (see docs/NOW-PLAYING-DSH.md §7.8)
en.npNowPlaying: Now playing (above Settings in the sidebar)
en.npNowPlaying.desc: Mounts an expandable player above the Settings entry in the left sidebar (on by default; it hides itself when the sidebar is collapsed). Its transport row is the wallpaper-sound control: previous/next follow the wallpaper folder's audio-track list order, play/pause drives the real media element, mute drives the existing mute setting. It yields automatically when another plugin already occupies the same slot (unmounted, state in data-mpw-np-yield). The only source is the current wallpaper's own audio; this plugin has no system media source (see docs/NOW-PLAYING-DSH.md §7.7)
en.overridden.indep: Independent now: Unified blur no longer changes this row (use the button to follow again)
en.perfNote4kAdvisory: High-resolution video source detected while wallpaper frosting is on: desktop may stutter noticeably. Set Resolution cap to 1080p in Settings (uses the host ffmpeg transcode), or set frosting to 0.
en.perfNote4kAuto: ≥4K video source detected: automatically lowered to 1080p (change it back in Settings)
en.persist.idb: This wallpaper is large — stored in IndexedDB (auto-restored after refresh/restart)
en.popoverAlpha.desc: How solid popover surfaces are. With blur working, ~80 still looks like glass; on engines without backdrop blur (Via/WebView) keep it above 94 so text behind stays unreadable
en.popoverBlur.desc: Panels popping out from somewhere: context menus, dropdowns, tooltip bubbles
en.powPauseBattery.desc: Do not play the wallpaper when on battery power; resume when plugged in
en.powPauseBlur.desc: Pause the wallpaper when the window loses focus, resume when refocused
en.powPauseHidden.desc: Pause the wallpaper video AND its audio when the page is hidden/in a background tab (including a web wallpaper's own sound; decoder to zero), resume on return
en.preScale.hint: When on, video wallpapers are first downscaled by ffmpeg to the screen's physical size (lanczos) before playback, cutting the flicker of a single big downscale; detail is a bit lower (measured: flicker reduced to 1/1.6–1/2.7, detail 1.4–1.9x lower) — off by default, enable if you prefer stability
en.preview.desc: This wallpaper is currently shown as a preview image (GIF/picture); the browser cannot play its dynamic content (Live2D scene / HD video requires the Wallpaper Engine app).
en.preview.title: Preview mode
en.props.desc: These are the wallpaper's own official options (project.json → general.properties), adjustable per item: changes are saved to this plugin's settings and pushed **live** to a loaded frame — web wallpapers via the same-origin shim channel, scene wallpapers via the cross-origin props channel (confirmed by a renderer receipt); for still-frame/video assets the picture reflects them after the next apply
en.props.hiddenByCond: Items hidden by the wallpaper's own condition:
en.props.title: Adjustable options
en.props.tvOff: Real-time variation is off — time settings hidden (enable it to show them)
en.resMax.hint: When the source resolution exceeds the cap, ffmpeg scales it down (aspect kept) to cut decode/GPU load (ffmpeg required)
en.rightSidebarAlpha.desc: White-fog density (%) on the right sidebar / dock surface: 0 = fully transparent (wallpaper only), 100 = fully opaque. Taken over by “Left sidebar / title-bar opacity” while following Unified blur.
en.rightSidebarBlur.desc: Adapts the built-in right sidebar and bottom dock overlays to the same frost rules. While Unified blur takes over, this whole group follows its two sliders.
en.rightSidebarBlur.overridden: Unified blur is on (and “UI blur follows Unified blur” is on): right sidebar/dock blur is handled by the Full-screen blur degree + Left sidebar / title-bar opacity; turn the follow switch off on the UI-blur page to make this group adjustable again
en.rightSidebarBlurAmount.desc: Backdrop blur radius (px) for the right sidebar / dock. While “UI blur follows Unified blur” is on and Unified blur is enabled, this is taken over by the Full-screen blur degree.
en.rot.empty: No carousel lists yet. Click "New list" to pick wallpapers, or scan the Steam library to auto-import WE playlists.
en.rot.intervalHint: Interval is set separately below after selecting a list
en.rot.noWallpapers: No wallpapers to pick (scan a wallpaper library first)
en.rot.pickHint: Check wallpapers to include in rotation
en.rot.title: Carousel list management
en.roundCompat.desc: Adds border-radius to rectangular containers injected by other plugins (does not override their own styles); turn off if it conflicts
en.scnRender.back: Renderer is back online; remounting the scene…
en.scnRender.bigPkg: This scene package is large; the first frame may be slow
en.scnRender.bigTex: This scene uses a large amount of textures; low-end devices may downsample automatically
en.scnRender.debug.cleared: Debug params cleared; default rendering restored
en.scnRender.debug.hint: Whitelist only: ln|eyehack|novideo|audit|ownsize|att|hier|nofx|np|whitefallback|skiny|trace|isolate|parallax|qflip. Each pair is validated before being appended to the wallpaper URL; invalid entries are dropped (dangerous flags like skin0 can never get in). Applies to the current scene immediately; clearing restores.
en.scnRender.desc: Choose the render path for pure scene wallpapers (does not affect video/image/web wallpapers).
en.scnRender.extUrl.empty: Enter the extension hooks URL first
en.scnRender.extUrl.hint: Empty = disabled. When set, it is passed to the scene iframe as extbase (see the renderer repo docs EXTENSION-HOOKS.md); press Test to verify the index and show the hook count.
en.scnRender.extUrl.saved: Extension hooks URL saved; takes effect the next time a scene wallpaper is applied
en.scnRender.hint: WebGL realtime = latest we-scene engine (full effects/animation/anchors); static frame = 2D canvas layer composite (lightweight); Elysia = reference implementation path (porting). Changes apply immediately and persist.
en.scnRender.report.desc: When on, the wallpaper sends the renderer's live state (screenshot + per-layer draw ledger + texture stats) to the renderer's reports/ folder every 10s, to diagnose position/visibility bugs. Debug only; off by default (writes to disk)
en.scnRender.retry.desc: When the current wallpaper is a scene: force-reload the renderer iframe and restart the first-frame watchdog (also works while fallen back; auto-rebuild is once per scene, manual is unlimited).
en.scnRender.retry.noScene: The current wallpaper is not a scene-renderer wallpaper
en.scnRender.retry.ok: Renderer remounted, waiting for the first frame…
en.scnRender.title: Pure scene wallpaper renderer
en.scnRender.watchdog.desc: If the renderer produces no frame within N seconds after applying a scene (no first-frame thumbnail posted), fall back to the static frame and explain in the hint bar; the iframe is kept and can be retried. Switches back automatically once the renderer delivers. Global escape: set localStorage mpwwatch=0
en.scnRender.watchdog.secs.desc: Increase on slow devices (3-30s, default 8s). The signal is the renderer's first-frame thumbnail beacon, independent of renderer reachability.
en.scnRender.wd.fallback: Scene renderer did not produce a frame in time; fallen back to the static frame. The renderer is kept — press “Remount renderer” in Settings → Scene rendering to retry.
en.scnRender.wd.recovered: Scene renderer delivered its first frame; live rendering restored
en.scnRender.wl.hint: By default only http(s) loopback targets (127.0.0.1 / localhost / ::1) and "same-host literal IPs" are accepted. A cross-origin renderer or extension-hook URL must have its origin listed here (comma or space separated); anything else is refused and falls back to 127.0.0.1:8902, with the refusal recorded in the diagnostics ledger (never silent). Note: a listed cross-origin upstream is also allowed to receive the scene token st — i.e. it can read that one scene.
en.scnRender.wl.saved: Allowlist saved; applies the next time a scene wallpaper is mounted
en.sec.appearance.desc: Panel opacity = frosted tint thickness of all areas; Frosted blur = how blurred the wallpaper itself is (0 = sharp); Lens zoom/position = zoom and pan of the background image (zoom out to see components at the picture edges)
en.sec.aqua.desc: Appearance ideas from Bil812 (PR #2), adopted and made into independent toggles (all OFF by default, original features untouched): adaptive ink = text follows background brightness + blue cleanup. (The unified-fog toggle moved to the Surface-unify tab, group ②; the panel-tint toggle moved to the Appearance tab, Theme-color area)
en.sec.blur.desc: Backdrop blur per area: dialogs (generic center windows + chat input), the settings panel and download/confirm popups each have their own switch; popovers = menus/dropdowns/tooltips; mask = the full-screen dim behind popups; right sidebar/dock = the built-in right panel and bottom dock. By default this page follows Unified blur: the taken-over rows (left sidebar frost, title-bar frost, right sidebar/dock) are driven by the Full-screen blur degree + Left sidebar / title-bar opacity.
en.sec.blurLeftTop.desc: Frost for these two surfaces: left-sidebar frost = the sidebar itself becomes glass (needs “Show wallpaper behind the sidebar” first); title-bar frost = the bar at the top of the chat column. While following Unified blur they stay identical to “UI transparency” + “Full-screen blur degree”; adjust one yourself to make it independent.
en.sec.blurRight.desc: The built-in right sidebar and bottom dock overlays (including better-sidebar panels and its bottom workbench). While following Unified blur this group is taken over and shares one surface color and thickness with the left sidebar.
en.sec.liquid.desc: Apple Liquid Glass effect test area. The master switch disables appearance features (blur/fog/theme/clock) while keeping wallpaper + float + layout, for testing the glass effect in a clean environment.
en.sec.show.desc: Whether the corresponding area shows the wallpaper: off = solid color, opaque
en.sec.unify.desc: One place manages the whole-surface look with two independent groups: ①Unified blur = wallpaper blur radius + fog thickness (the whole UI shell — left sidebar, title bar, right sidebar, dock — becomes frosted glass together); ②Unified fog = full-screen color mist shared by every surface. While Unified blur is on, the taken-over rows on the “UI blur” page follow these two sliders (turn “UI blur follows Unified blur” off there to decouple them).
en.sec.unifyFog.desc: Full-screen solid-color mist: every surface (sidebar/title bar/chat/buttons) shares one fog color and density for a unified tint; off = keep per-area colors
en.sessionFollow.desc: When unified blur is on: whether the New chat button follows the Opacity slider. Off = keeps its original button color
en.settingsBlur.desc: Backdrop blur of the DSH settings panel (the panel hosting this plugin's settings), with its own strength independent of generic dialogs
en.sharp.desc: Improves low-res GIF look; disable if animation stutters
en.sidebar.desc: Off keeps the left sidebar opaque so left/right translucency stays consistent
en.sidebar.unifyHint: Unified blur is on: left sidebar translucency follows the Surface opacity slider (turn this switch off for a fully opaque left sidebar)
en.sidebarAlpha.desc: Transparency of the whole UI shell (left sidebar / title bar / right sidebar · dock): 0% = fully opaque (the normal UI, painted with the host's own surface colour); 100% = fully transparent (wallpaper visible). Independent of the blur: with the blur at 0 it still applies, only the wallpaper behind is sharp.
en.sidebarBlur.desc: The sidebar itself becomes glass (backdrop-filter blurs the wallpaper behind it, Aqua-style); automatically lifted while a dialog is open so the blur layer cannot trap fixed popups
en.sidebarBlur.needReveal: Turn on the sidebar wallpaper reveal first to use sidebar frost (controlled by the sidebar reveal)
en.sidebarBlur.overridden: Unified blur is on: left sidebar frost is taken over by the Full-screen blur degree + Left sidebar / title-bar opacity. Turn off “UI blur follows Unified blur” on the UI-blur page to adjust this switch again
en.speed.hint: Video wallpaper playback speed (0.5x–2x, native player rate, instant, no reload)
en.themeAssist.desc: When the host base colour is made translucent, the app frame still paints opaque over the wallpaper: this only clears the frame fill after detecting a translucent base AND an active wallpaper (no-op on default themes, fully restorable)
en.themeColor.hint: Tints the left sidebar / title bar / new-session button / settings dialog background (picker + presets); brand interactive elements (buttons/selection/links) are controlled by the Aqua “Accent color”; empty = disabled
en.thinkBg.desc: On: show a blurred background box behind the Deep diving thinking status; Off (default): transparent, text sits directly on the wallpaper
en.time.locked: Slot locked manually; auto-switching paused (press Auto to resume)
en.title: Wallpaper Engine mpkg background
en.todoBlur.desc: Frosted background for the task (todo) cards in the conversation, collapsed and expanded alike (like the title-bar/sidebar frost; off by default)
en.transcode.directRetry: This video is directly playable in the browser — transcoding was NOT started (avoids a background ffmpeg hogging RAM/CPU); retrying the original once
en.transcode.fallback: Transcode failed (ffmpeg missing or resolution/fps cap too high); playing the original. Install ffmpeg or set Resolution/FPS caps to Unlimited
en.unifyAmount.desc: Blur radius (px) for the whole screen: 0 = no blur at all (the wallpaper is fully sharp and the title bar / sidebar / right sidebar / dock return to a solid surface — no raw wallpaper showing through); 40 = heavy frosted glass. While Unified blur is on this is the only blur source for the UI shell.
en.unifyTint.desc: On: the whole UI shell (left sidebar / title bar / right sidebar / dock) becomes one seamless frosted glass; blur radius by the Full-screen blur degree, surface fog thickness by the Left sidebar / title-bar opacity slider. The rows taken over on the UI-blur page follow these two sliders by default (turn “UI blur follows Unified blur” off there to decouple them). Off = per-area control
en.update.applied: Update done! Restart dsh web and Ctrl+F5
en.update.chooseBody: Prefer updating from the plugin market (semver check matches the market). Still update directly via this plugin (pull GitHub code and write it back locally)? v
en.update.diff: Local code differs from GitHub (same version — probably un-pushed local changes); push to align
en.update.gotoMarket: Go update it in the plugin market (dshmarket) instead (recommended, matches the market version check)
en.update.readonly: Installed via the market (plugin dir is read-only), so in-place update is unavailable — update from the plugin market or via dsh plugin update
en.update.title: Check for updates
en.url.label: Image URL (GIF data: URLs work too)
en.url.unsafe: Only http/https or data:image URLs are allowed
en.web.confirmBody: Web wallpapers may freeze or fail to load
en.web.confirmHint: Some web wallpapers (event pages / heavy animations) can freeze the UI on low-end devices; if frozen, refresh the page to recover (it will not auto-reload). If loading fails, the wallpaper shows a black screen with a refresh button — that is the wallpaper's own content, not a bug.
en.web.modeHint: Sandbox mode: the host injects the WE API (wallpaperPropertyListener / audio / media) before author scripts, and the plugin drives properties plus mute/speed/pause; the frame is an opaque origin, so wallpaper scripts cannot reach the DSH UI or local storage. Compatibility mode: same-origin (the old behaviour) — required by the "Web wallpaper options" (resolution / language / volume) of Live2D-style wallpapers.
en.web.riskExternal: ⚠ Preflight: depends on external resources (SDK/CDN) — may fail to load
en.web.riskHeavy: ⚠ Preflight: Spine/L2D skeletal-animation wallpaper — may freeze the UI on low-end devices
en.webcfg.desc: This wallpaper has built-in options (resolution/language/volume); its built-in panel is hidden, adjust here
en.webcfg.noFrame: Wallpaper not loaded yet, wait a moment
en.webcfg.readFail: Could not read the wallpaper's own settings (nothing was written back, so your existing options are not overwritten):
en.webcfg.sandboxHint: The wallpaper currently runs in sandbox mode (its frame is not same-origin), so its own localStorage cannot be read or written. Re-apply this wallpaper with "Compatibility mode (same-origin)" to change these options.
en.webcfg.title: Web wallpaper options
en.webframe.autoCompat.desc: Off by default. While off, auto mode degrades only inside the sandbox (reloads without the WE API shim, still opaque-origin) and never upgrades to same-origin; when enabled it may switch to compat when the browser blocks the wallpaper — which means **this third-party wallpaper's scripts run same-origin with DSH** (they can reach the host UI and local storage). Enable only for a wallpaper you know needs same-origin; the status line and ledger record the risk.
en.webframe.escape: Escape hatch: append ?webframe=auto|sandbox|compat to the address bar to override this setting for the current page.
en.webframe.hint: Auto = start sandboxed; if the browser blocks it or the WE API shim never reports it degrades **inside the sandbox only** (reloads without the shim marker, still opaque-origin) — it never auto-upgrades to same-origin, and the reason is written to the ledger and status line; Sandbox = opaque-origin isolation (the wallpaper cannot reach the DSH UI or local storage) and never degrades automatically — the reason is shown here; Compat = same-origin loading (equivalent to the old bare iframe), only ever chosen explicitly by the user (required by Live2D-style option panels).
en.webframe.label: Web frame mode (web wallpapers)
en.webrisk.external: Preflight: the entry HTML references external resources (SDK/CDN) — may fail to load when offline or behind a firewall
en.webrisk.heavy: Preflight: the folder contains Spine/Live2D skeletal-animation assets — may freeze the UI on low-end devices
